## What changed

Describe the smallest coherent change.

## Why

What concrete problem does this solve?

## Compatibility

- [ ] No public API change
- [ ] Public API change is additive
- [ ] Breaking/provisional API change is documented
- [ ] Durable identity/version implications reviewed

## Architecture

- [ ] No new Core primitive, or necessity is explicitly justified
- [ ] `uair lint` / architecture governance passes where applicable
- [ ] Cross-package public boundaries are respected

## Verification

- [ ] Build passes
- [ ] Relevant deterministic checks pass
- [ ] Docs/tests updated
- [ ] No secrets, generated build output, tarballs, or local state committed

## Security

- [ ] Extension/package changes preserve approval ≠ trust/authorization
- [ ] Security-sensitive behavior has hostile/negative-path coverage where relevant
